user_prompt:

Can you list every skincare product in your store (cleansers, toners, serums, moisturizers and sunscreens) that is fragrance-free, is listed as suitable for sensitive skin, and costs me less than $35? Include every size that qualifies, as separate entries. I want to order today, so only things in stock.

Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every product size that meets all of my conditions. If nothing matches, return an empty list.

You may think step by step first. End your reply with the JSON object inside a ```json code block.
